newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australia June qtr gold output seen at record.
newsitem.headline: Australia June qtr gold output seen at record.

text.p: Australia's gold production for the quarter ended June 30, 1997 is forecast to rise to a record 78 tonnes, mining consulting group Surbiton Associates Pty Ltd said on Monday.
The June quarter forecast production is about five tonnes more than the March quarter and two tonnes above the record 75.8 tonnes produced in the December quarter 1996, Surbiton said.

"Although figures for only half of all operations have been reported, it is already clear that gold output in the June quarter will exceed the previous record by a substiantial margin," Surbiton managing director Sandra Close said.
